description: The image displays a series of stacked bar charts comparing the performance of two models, 70B llama and 8B llama, across three distinct domains: Health and Nutrition, Logistics, and Personal Finance. Each chart presents the contribution of two components—MVS (represented by green bars) and 1-MVS (represented by blue bars)—to the total performance, which is normalized to 1.0 on the vertical axis. In the Health and Nutrition domain, the 70B llama model shows a higher MVS component (approximately 0.6) compared to the 8B llama model (approximately 0.4), with the 1-MVS component being 0.4 and 0.6 respectively. In the Logistics domain, the 70B llama model has an MVS component of approximately 0.55 and a 1-MVS component of 0.45, while the 8B llama model has an MVS component of approximately 0.5 and a 1-MVS component of 0.5. In the Personal Finance domain, the 70B llama model shows an MVS component of approximately 0.75 and a 1-MVS component of 0.25, whereas the 8B llama model has an MVS component of approximately 0.4 and a 1-MVS component of 0.6. The legend at the bottom indicates that the green bars represent MVS and the blue bars represent 1-MVS. The charts are arranged in a row, with each domain having its own chart, and the models are compared within each domain. The bars are sorted in descending order of the MVS component for each model within each domain.
